rule: Adopt the behavior, never the visual identity. Every entry maps a job to the best-in-class behavior and to the Jovie primitive that should express it. A pattern with primitive null is a design-system gap and is built once, then reused.

patterns.job: Confirm a payment and land the user in the paid product

leaders.name: Stripe Checkout / Elements
leaders.behavior: Button morphs to a spinner without changing width, then to an animated check; the success state is acknowledged before navigation; errors are inline, specific and keep entered card data
leaders.reference: stripe.com/payments/checkout, success and processing states of the hosted page

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Upgrade lands on the feature just unlocked with a brief confirmation, no interstitial dead end

checks: failure keeps inputs and offers retry

patterns.job: Mark the moment an artist's profile goes live

leaders.name: Stripe Dashboard
leaders.behavior: Account activation shows a single clear completed state with the next action

leaders.name: Apple HIG (Feedback, Onboarding)
leaders.behavior: Celebrate rarely and briefly; confirmation is tied to the user's action, not decorative

checks: link to the live profile is the primary action

patterns.job: Mark the first release published to the artist's page

leaders.name: Frame.io
leaders.behavior: Upload progress is continuous and resumable; completion resolves in place into the finished asset

leaders.name: Things
leaders.behavior: Completion is a small physical animation, then the item settles into its final position

checks: empty to filled swap does not shift layout

patterns.job: Tell the artist their first fan arrived

leaders.name: Stripe Dashboard
leaders.behavior: First payment moment shown as a notification with the specific amount and source

leaders.name: Raycast
leaders.behavior: Success confirmation is a short HUD, never a modal

patterns.job: Create or edit a record in a drawer or dialog without losing input

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Typed text and focus survive re-renders; Escape on a dirty form asks before discarding; Cmd+Enter submits

leaders.name: Apple HIG (Sheets)
leaders.behavior: Dirty sheets confirm before dismiss

checks: focus returns to trigger on close

patterns.job: Change data with instant feedback and a safe way back

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Optimistic update with toast and Undo; failures roll back with the reason

leaders.name: Things
leaders.behavior: Every destructive action is undoable

patterns.job: Show that content is coming without layout shift

leaders.name: Vercel
leaders.behavior: Skeletons match final geometry; content fades in without reflow

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Cached content renders instantly, refresh is silent

patterns.job: Teach the next action when there is no data

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Empty states name one primary action and a shortcut

leaders.name: Apple HIG (Empty states)
leaders.behavior: Explain what belongs here and how to add it

leaders.name: Raycast
leaders.behavior: Every action reachable by keyboard, shortcuts shown inline, no animation on keyboard-initiated actions

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: g-sequences and Cmd+K

leaders.name: Stripe
leaders.behavior: Linear step indicator, resume where left off

leaders.name: Frame.io
leaders.behavior: Per-file progress with ETA

patterns.job: Fail without losing the user's work

leaders.name: Stripe Elements
leaders.behavior: Inline error by the field, specific copy, focus moved to the first invalid field

leaders.name: Apple HIG (Alerts)
leaders.behavior: Say what failed and what to do

leaders.name: Linear
leaders.behavior: Local-first reads, queued writes, subtle status

leaders.name: Things
leaders.behavior: Works fully offline

sharedPrimitivesToBuild.contract: animated check (token durations), aria-live polite, reduced-motion static, stable geometry, story per state
wraps Confetti; once-per-event; skippable; reduced-motion no-op; non-blocking
progressbar semantics, resume, determinate and indeterminate
layout-stable swap from empty state to first content with a single token-timed transition
